ideas.title: The Impact of Minnesota's Childcare Fraud on Local Families
ideas.description: Investigate how the alleged fraud in Minnesota's childcare program affects local families and what measures are being taken to address the issue.
ideas.angle: The human impact of the fraud and potential solutions
ideas.insight: This story would explore the real-world consequences of the fraud on Minnesota families and potential policy responses.

ideas.title: The Role of Somali Community in Minnesota's Childcare Fraud
ideas.description: Explore allegations that the Somali community is being unfairly targeted in the investigation into Minnesota's childcare fraud.
ideas.angle: The potential for racial or ethnic bias in the investigation
questions: Are there disparities in how providers from different communities are treated?
What evidence supports or refutes claims of bias?
ideas.insight: This story could examine whether there's evidence of bias in how the investigation is being conducted and its impact on the Somali community.
